summary_for_children: Al-Qadr tells that the Quran was sent down on the Night of Decree, better than a thousand months, a night of peace until dawn.
environment_concept: A still night. A long low wall holds a thousand tiny lamps, one for each month, for 97:3. Beyond it, a quiet hill faces the east, where the sky slowly brightens toward dawn (97:5). The angels and the Spirit of 97:4 are not pictured; no person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A long wall with a thousand small lamp niches, a hilltop with low seats facing east.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A flat village rooftop in the last nights of Ramadan with a prayer mat, a string of lamps and an old counting frame

primary_mechanic.text: Count exactly 1000 months on a counting frame with steps of 120, 12 and 1 (going past 1000 is refused): 83 years and 4 months. Then keep the night still on the prayer mat for three watches; stepping off restarts the watch; the sky moves from night to the full moon to the last of the night to dawn (97:3-5).

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading in the lane, the counting and the vigil, then a reading by the stair
environment_behaviour: the sky turns watch by watch toward dawn
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that the Night of Decree is better than a thousand months (97:3)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Blessed Night
story_library.children_narration: Surah Al-Qadr tells us about the Night of Decree, a night better than a thousand months. It is a night of great blessing and peace until dawn. The surah reminds us of the importance of revelation and worship.

world_idea.title: The Night of Peace
world_idea.description: Explore an atmospheric nighttime environment, observe a gradual transition toward dawn, and learn about the surah through recitation. Do not depict angels or the unseen events of the night.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
